target: Integrate opt-in local Summary V2 on released 2.19.4 while preserving capture compatibility and paused runtime settings.
invariants: Raw and existing summaries are immutable
Capture remains independent and all 2.19.4 native changes are retained
No private history or device configuration is published
No automatic model calls, activation, history repair or old-node rebinding
Only same-SHA passing candidate CI may enter the existing release workflow
prohibited_changes: Overwriting the prior dirty integration checkout
Installing into the local runtime or resuming its paused tasks
before_after_checks: Existing platform and capture regression suite
V2 lifecycle, failure isolation, source identity and replay fixtures
Default model and explicit medium argv without cloud calls
Closed runtime manifest and both installer payload inclusion
Exact mainline CI commit and installer release assets
rollback: Keep the prior published version and local paused installation. Disable V2 generation while retaining V2-aware reads; never install a V1-only reader over adopted V2 state.
promotion_review: Project-only integration and model policy; no new global rules.

original_triggers: Closed timeout rescue, interpreter identity, model default drift and preserved Mac capture history compatibility.
